# Official EN16931 1.3.17 examples

Ten unmodified examples from ConnectingEurope eInvoicing-EN16931 release
`validation-1.3.17` (12 October 2026 UTC), licensed EUPL 1.2. Against
1.3.16, only `CII_example3.xml` changed upstream (one
`SpecifiedTradeSettlementPaymentMeans` block removed).

Source: https://github.com/ConnectingEurope/eInvoicing-EN16931/releases/tag/validation-1.3.17

`CII_example2.xml` (duplicate of `CII_business_example_01.xml`) is not
included. No other examples are included.

Checksums: `SHA256SUMS`.
